name: calypso
title: Calypso
description: Chat with any self-hosted or OpenAI-compatible model, with web search, private-knowledge (RAG) and page-fetch tools — in a Raycast command and as an AI Extension you can @mention in AI Chat.
author: jonathan_mallinger

commands.name: chat
commands.title: Chat with Calypso
commands.description: Multi-turn conversation with your model. Follow-ups keep the thread; web search, knowledge search and page fetch stay available across turns.

commands.name: ask-calypso
commands.title: Ask Calypso
commands.subtitle: Auto-select endpoint
commands.description: Ask whichever configured endpoint answers first, falling back to the cloud provider.

commands.name: calypso-status
commands.title: Calypso Status
commands.subtitle: Configured endpoints
commands.description: Health, loaded model and context size for both configured endpoints.

commands.name: ask-calypso-1
commands.title: Ask Fallback Endpoint
commands.subtitle: Secondary server
commands.description: Ask the fallback endpoint specifically; falls back only to the cloud provider.

commands.name: ask-calypso-2
commands.title: Ask Primary Endpoint
commands.subtitle: Primary server
commands.description: Ask the primary endpoint specifically; falls back only to the cloud provider.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of your primary model server (llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, or any hosted provider).

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Model id as served by your endpoint. Leave blank to use whatever the server loads by default.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional bearer token. Leave blank if your server needs no auth.

preferences.name: maxTokens
preferences.title: Max Tokens
preferences.description: Upper bound on the response. If your server reserves a reasoning budget, keep this well above it — the think block is spent first and a tight cap returns an empty answer.

preferences.name: temperature
preferences.title: Temperature
preferences.description: Leave blank to use each endpoint's built-in sampling defaults. Set a value to override both endpoints.

preferences.name: systemPrompt
preferences.title: System Prompt
preferences.description: Optional system message prepended to every request.

preferences.name: showReasoning
preferences.title: Show Reasoning
preferences.label: Render the model's think block above the answer
preferences.description: Render the model's think block above the answer instead of hiding it.

preferences.name: fallbackBaseUrl
preferences.title: Fallback Base URL
preferences.description: Optional second endpoint, tried when the primary does not respond.

preferences.name: fallbackModel
preferences.title: Fallback Model
preferences.description: Model id at the fallback endpoint. Leave blank to use that server's default.

preferences.name: preferredEndpoint
preferences.title: Preferred Endpoint
preferences.description: Which endpoint to try first. Auto prefers the primary. Pinning one still falls back if it is unreachable.

preferences.name: enableTools
preferences.title: Tools
preferences.label: Let the model call web search, the knowledge base, and page fetch
preferences.description: Requires a server built with tool-calling support (for llama.cpp, run it with --jinja). If the server rejects tools the extension silently answers without them.

preferences.name: maxToolRounds
preferences.title: Max Tool Rounds
preferences.description: How many times the model may call tools before it must answer. Capped at 8.

preferences.name: searxngUrl
preferences.title: SearXNG URL
preferences.description: Base URL of a SearXNG instance for the web_search tool. Leave blank to disable web search.

preferences.name: ragUrl
preferences.title: RAG API URL
preferences.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible RAG service exposing POST /v1/search. Leave blank to disable knowledge search.

preferences.name: ragApiKey
preferences.title: RAG API Key
preferences.description: API key for your RAG service, sent as the x-api-key header. Leave blank if your RAG needs no auth.

preferences.name: ragCollection
preferences.title: RAG Collection
preferences.description: Restrict rag_search to one collection. Leave blank to search everything.

preferences.name: firecrawlUrl
preferences.title: Firecrawl URL
preferences.description: Base URL of a Firecrawl instance for page fetching. Leave blank to disable page fetch.

preferences.name: cloudProvider
preferences.title: Cloud Fallback
preferences.description: Provider to use when no local rig answers.

preferences.name: cloudApiKey
preferences.title: Cloud API Key
preferences.description: API key for the chosen cloud fallback provider. Without it the fallback stays off.

preferences.name: cloudModel
preferences.title: Cloud Model
preferences.description: Model id at the cloud provider. Blank uses that provider's default.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1

tools.name: search-web
tools.title: Search Web
tools.description: Search the web using a self-hosted SearXNG instance. Use for current events, documentation and anything public.

tools.name: search-knowledge
tools.title: Search Knowledge Base
tools.description: Search the user's PRIVATE knowledge base (RAG) for their internal projects, research notes and prior work. Use this before the web for anything about their own systems — this content is not public.

tools.name: fetch-page
tools.title: Fetch Page
tools.description: Fetch a specific URL and return it as markdown, via self-hosted Firecrawl.

tools.name: ask-calypso
tools.title: Ask Calypso
tools.description: Put a question to the user's own model and return its answer. Use when the question benefits from a locally-hosted model that runs its own search and knowledge-base rounds internally.

This domain is for use in illustrative examples.
